prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: full-bleed architectural background for a static university prototype. Reference image defines the existing university interior: warm timber pitched roof and beams, glazed garden views with mountains and copper-roof pavilions, stone floor, natural daylight, detailed credible plants. Preserve that same physical place and photographic realism. Landscape 16:10. No UI, text, lettering, signs, numbers, logos, watermarks or montage. Create the adjacent professional-services corridor reached from this reception. View along a spacious gently receding timber corridor. Exactly seven distinct full-height wooden glazed office doors, four along the left and three on right, naturally distributed in perspective. Clear walking space, no desks in corridor, quiet glass garden at far end. Doors occupy middle band, large enough to click. No people. Warm welcoming academic building, not shopping mall.
